description: List bottles in the signed-in user's collection. Filters: status (unopened|opened|consumed|excluded|wishlist|active|tried) and optional text query. Always scoped to the token uid — a userId argument is ignored.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response (numeric offset)

query.description: Filter by display name, distillery, or notes

status.description: Bottle status or shelf group (active / wishlist / tried)
